messages.content: How do we build an Android app with Jetpack Compose?

Building a modern Android application with Jetpack Compose requires adopting a declarative paradigm rooted in Unidirectional Data Flow (UDF), immutability, and reactive state management. 

Below is an end-to-end, production-grade architectural blueprint and implementation demonstrating modern Android development standards: Kotlin 2.0+ Compose Compiler, Material 3, Type-Safe Navigation, MVVM/MVI hybrid state management with coroutine-based repositories, and complete test suites.

---

### Architectural Foundations

```
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                      UI Layer                          │
│  [Composables] <───(UiState)───── [ViewModel]          │
│        │                               ▲               │
│        └───────────(Events)────────────┘               │
└────────────────────────┬───────────────────────────────┘
                         │ Calls UseCases / Repositories
┌────────────────────────▼───────────────────────────────┐
│                     Domain Layer                       │
│              [Data Models & Business Rules]            │
└────────────────────────┬───────────────────────────────┘
                         │ Interacts with Interfaces
┌────────────────────────▼───────────────────────────────┐
│                      Data Layer                        │
│    [Local DB (Room)]  <───>  [Remote API (Ktor/Retrofit)]
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

1. **State Hoisting & UDF**: UI components never mutate state directly. They emit UI events upward; the `ViewModel` processes them and exposes an immutable `StateFlow<UiState>` collected lifecycle-safely via `collectAsStateWithLifecycle()`.
2. **Recomposition Optimization**: Use `@Immutable` and `@Stable` annotations to signal compiler guarantees and prevent unnecessary recomposition trees.
3. **Type-Safe Navigation**: AndroidX Navigation 2.8+ utilizes Kotlin Serialization (`@Serializable`) objects/classes instead of raw string route schemas.

---

### 2. Domain & Data Layer

A fully functional reactive data layer utilizing a Thread-Safe In-Memory Repository with deterministic failure injections and latency simulation.

#### `model/Task.kt`

```kotlin
package com.enterprise.app.model

import androidx.compose.runtime.Immutable
import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable

enum class Priority { LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH }

@Immutable
@Serializable
data class Task(
    val id: String,
    val title: String,
    val description: String,
    val isCompleted: Boolean = false,
    val priority: Priority = Priority.MEDIUM
)
```

#### `data/TaskRepository.kt`

```kotlin
package com.enterprise.app.data

import com.enterprise.app.model.Priority
import com.enterprise.app.model.Task
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineDispatcher
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.delay
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.update
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import java.util.UUID

interface TaskRepository {
    fun observeTasks(): Flow<List<Task>>
    suspend fun getTaskById(id: String): Result<Task>
    suspend fun createTask(title: String, description: String, priority: Priority): Result<Task>
    suspend fun toggleTaskStatus(id: String): Result<Unit>
    suspend fun deleteTask(id: String): Result<Unit>
}

class DefaultTaskRepository(
    private val ioDispatcher: CoroutineDispatcher = Dispatchers.IO
) : TaskRepository {

    private val tasksFlow = MutableStateFlow<Map<String, Task>>(
        linkedMapOf(
            "1" to Task("1", "Setup CI/CD Pipeline", "Configure GitHub Actions for automated unit checks", true, Priority.HIGH),
            "2" to Task("2", "Write Compose Unit Tests", "Verify edge-cases in Navigation and ViewModel", false, Priority.HIGH),
            "3" to Task("3", "Implement Material3 Dynamic Theming", "Verify contrast ratios on OLED surfaces", false, Priority.MEDIUM)
        )
    )

    override fun observeTasks(): Flow<List<Task>> =
        tasksFlow.asStateFlow().map { it.values.toList() }

    override suspend fun getTaskById(id: String): Result<Task> = withContext(ioDispatcher) {
        delay(100) // Simulate network/disk latency
        tasksFlow.value[id]?.let { Result.success(it) } 
            ?: Result.failure(NoSuchElementException("Task with id $id not found"))
    }

    override suspend fun createTask(title: String, description: String, priority: Priority): Result<Task> =
        withContext(ioDispatcher) {
            if (title.isBlank()) {
                return@withContext Result.failure(IllegalArgumentException("Title cannot be blank"))
            }
            val newTask = Task(
                id = UUID.randomUUID().toString(),
                title = title.trim(),
                description = description.trim(),
                isCompleted = false,
                priority = priority
            )
            tasksFlow.update { current ->
                val updated = LinkedHashMap(current)
                updated[newTask.id] = newTask
                updated
            }
            Result.success(newTask)
        }

    override suspend fun toggleTaskStatus(id: String): Result<Unit> = withContext(ioDispatcher) {
        var found = false
        tasksFlow.update { current ->
            val updated = LinkedHashMap(current)
            val existing = updated[id]
            if (existing != null) {
                updated[id] = existing.copy(isCompleted = !existing.isCompleted)
                found = true
            }
            updated
        }
        if (found) Result.success(Unit) else Result.failure(NoSuchElementException("Task $id not found"))
    }

    override suspend fun deleteTask(id: String): Result<Unit> = withContext(ioDispatcher) {
        var removed = false
        tasksFlow.update { current ->
            val updated = LinkedHashMap(current)
            if (updated.remove(id) != null) {
                removed = true
            }
            updated
        }
        if (removed) Result.success(Unit) else Result.failure(NoSuchElementException("Task $id not found"))
    }
}
```

### 3. Presentation Layer: State & ViewModel

Using explicit Contracts via `UiState` and `UiAction`.

#### `presentation/TaskContract.kt`

```kotlin
package com.enterprise.app.presentation

import androidx.compose.runtime.Immutable
import com.enterprise.app.model.Priority
import com.enterprise.app.model.Task

@Immutable
sealed interface TaskUiState {
    data object Loading : TaskUiState
    data class Success(
        val tasks: List<Task>,
        val filterCompleted: Boolean = false,
        val searchQuery: String = ""
    ) : TaskUiState
    data class Error(val message: String) : TaskUiState
}

sealed interface TaskUiAction {
    data class SearchQueryChanged(val query: String) : TaskUiAction
    data class FilterToggleToggled(val filterCompleted: Boolean) : TaskUiAction
    data class ToggleTaskCompletion(val taskId: String) : TaskUiAction
    data class DeleteTask(val taskId: String) : TaskUiAction
    data class CreateTask(val title: String, val description: String, val priority: Priority) : TaskUiAction
    data object RetryLoading : TaskUiAction
}
```

#### `presentation/TaskViewModel.kt`

```kotlin
package com.enterprise.app.presentation

import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import com.enterprise.app.data.TaskRepository
import com.enterprise.app.model.Priority
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableSharedFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.SharingStarted
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asSharedFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.combine
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.stateIn
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

class TaskViewModel(
    private val repository: TaskRepository
) : ViewModel() {

    private val searchQuery = MutableStateFlow("")
    private val filterCompleted = MutableStateFlow(false)
    private val userFacingMessages = MutableSharedFlow<String>()
    val notifications = userFacingMessages.asSharedFlow()

    val uiState: StateFlow<TaskUiState> = combine(
        repository.observeTasks(),
        searchQuery,
        filterCompleted
    ) { tasks, query, filter ->
        val filtered = tasks.filter { task ->
            val matchesQuery = task.title.contains(query, ignoreCase = true) || 
                               task.description.contains(query, ignoreCase = true)
            val matchesFilter = if (filter) !task.isCompleted else true
            matchesQuery && matchesFilter
        }
        TaskUiState.Success(
            tasks = filtered,
            filterCompleted = filter,
            searchQuery = query
        ) as TaskUiState
    }.stateIn(
        scope = viewModelScope,
        started = SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5_000L),
        initialValue = TaskUiState.Loading
    )

    fun onAction(action: TaskUiAction) {
        when (action) {
            is TaskUiAction.SearchQueryChanged -> searchQuery.value = action.query
            is TaskUiAction.FilterToggleToggled -> filterCompleted.value = action.filterCompleted
            is TaskUiAction.ToggleTaskCompletion -> toggleTask(action.taskId)
            is TaskUiAction.DeleteTask -> deleteTask(action.taskId)
            is TaskUiAction.CreateTask -> createTask(action.title, action.description, action.priority)
            is TaskUiAction.RetryLoading -> { /* Trigger reload logic if cached in state */ }
        }
    }

    private fun toggleTask(id: String) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            repository.toggleTaskStatus(id).onFailure { error ->
                userFacingMessages.emit(error.message ?: "Failed to update task")
            }
        }
    }

    private fun deleteTask(id: String) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            repository.deleteTask(id).onFailure { error ->
                userFacingMessages.emit(error.message ?: "Failed to delete task")
            }
        }
    }

    private fun createTask(title: String, description: String, priority: Priority) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            repository.createTask(title, description, priority).onFailure { error ->
                userFacingMessages.emit(error.message ?: "Failed to create task")
            }
        }
    }
}
```

### 4. UI Layer: Jetpack Compose Implementation

#### `ui/theme/Theme.kt`

```kotlin
package com.enterprise.app.ui.theme

import android.os.Build
import androidx.compose.foundation.isSystemInDarkTheme
import androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme
import androidx.compose.material3.darkColorScheme
import androidx.compose.material3.dynamicDarkColorScheme
import androidx.compose.material3.dynamicLightColorScheme
import androidx.compose.material3.lightColorScheme
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalContext

private val DarkColorScheme = darkColorScheme(
    primary = Color(0xFFD0BCFF),
    secondary = Color(0xFFCCC2DC),
    tertiary = Color(0xFFEFB8C8),
    background = Color(0xFF1C1B1F),
    surface = Color(0xFF1C1B1F),
    surfaceVariant = Color(0xFF49454F)
)

private val LightColorScheme = lightColorScheme(
    primary = Color(0xFF6750A4),
    secondary = Color(0xFF625B71),
    tertiary = Color(0xFF7D5260),
    background = Color(0xFFFFFBFE),
    surface = Color(0xFFFFFBFE),
    surfaceVariant = Color(0xFFE7E0EC)
)

@Composable
fun EnterpriseAppTheme(
    darkTheme: Boolean = isSystemInDarkTheme(),
    dynamicColor: Boolean = true,
    content: @Composable () -> Unit
) {
    val colorScheme = when {
        dynamicColor && Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.S -> {
            val context = LocalContext.current
            if (darkTheme) dynamicDarkColorScheme(context) else dynamicLightColorScheme(context)
        }
        darkTheme -> DarkColorScheme
        else -> LightColorScheme
    }

    MaterialTheme(
        colorScheme = colorScheme,
        content = content
    )
}
```

Demonstrating Slot APIs, State Hoisting, Adaptive Modals, and accessibility support.

package com.enterprise.app.ui.screens

import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.collectLatest

@Composable
fun TaskListRoute(
    uiState: TaskUiState,
    notifications: Flow<String>,
    onAction: (TaskUiAction) -> Unit,
    onNavigateToDetail: (String) -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier
) {
    val snackbarHostState = remember { SnackbarHostState() }
    var isCreateSheetOpen by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(false) }

    LaunchedEffect(notifications) {
        notifications.collectLatest { message ->
            snackbarHostState.showSnackbar(message)
        }
    }

    Scaffold(
        modifier = modifier.fillMaxSize(),
        snackbarHost = { SnackbarHost(snackbarHostState) },
        topBar = {
            TopAppBar(
                title = { Text("Task Engine") },
                colors = TopAppBarDefaults.topAppBarColors(
                    containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surfaceVariant
                )
            )
        },
        floatingActionButton = {
            FloatingActionButton(
                onClick = { isCreateSheetOpen = true },
                modifier = Modifier.testTag("AddTaskFAB")
            ) {
                Icon(Icons.Default.Add, contentDescription = "Add Task")
            }
        }
    ) { innerPadding ->
        Box(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxSize()
                .padding(innerPadding)
        ) {
            when (uiState) {
                is TaskUiState.Loading -> {
                    CircularProgressIndicator(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .align(Alignment.Center)
                            .testTag("LoadingIndicator")
                    )
                }
                is TaskUiState.Error -> {
                    Column(
                        modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.Center),
                        horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally
                    ) {
                        Text(text = uiState.message, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.error)
                        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(8.dp))
                        Button(onClick = { onAction(TaskUiAction.RetryLoading) }) {
                            Text("Retry")
                        }
                    }
                }
                is TaskUiState.Success -> {
                    TaskListContent(
                        state = uiState,
                        onAction = onAction,
                        onTaskClick = onNavigateToDetail,
                        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()
                    )
                }
            }

            if (isCreateSheetOpen) {
                CreateTaskBottomSheet(
                    onDismiss = { isCreateSheetOpen = false },
                    onConfirm = { title, desc, priority ->
                        onAction(TaskUiAction.CreateTask(title, desc, priority))
                        isCreateSheetOpen = false
                    }
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun TaskListContent(
    state: TaskUiState.Success,
    onAction: (TaskUiAction) -> Unit,
    onTaskClick: (String) -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier
) {
    Column(modifier = modifier) {
        OutlinedTextField(
            value = state.searchQuery,
            onValueChange = { onAction(TaskUiAction.SearchQueryChanged(it)) },
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .padding(horizontal = 16.dp, vertical = 8.dp)
                .testTag("SearchInput"),
            placeholder = { Text("Search by title or description...") },
            leadingIcon = { Icon(Icons.Default.Search, contentDescription = null) },
            singleLine = true
        )

        Row(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .padding(horizontal = 16.dp),
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
        ) {
            FilterChip(
                selected = state.filterCompleted,
                onClick = { onAction(TaskUiAction.FilterToggleToggled(!state.filterCompleted)) },
                label = { Text("Active Only") },
                leadingIcon = {
                    Icon(
                        imageVector = Icons.Default.FilterList,
                        contentDescription = null,
                        modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp)
                    )
                }
            )
        }

        if (state.tasks.isEmpty()) {
            Box(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                Text(
                    text = "No tasks found",
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyLarge,
                    color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
                )
            }
        } else {
            LazyColumn(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                contentPadding = PaddingValues(16.dp),
                verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)
            ) {
                items(
                    items = state.tasks,
                    key = { task -> task.id }
                ) { task ->
                    TaskCard(
                        task = task,
                        onToggle = { onAction(TaskUiAction.ToggleTaskCompletion(task.id)) },
                        onDelete = { onAction(TaskUiAction.DeleteTask(task.id)) },
                        onClick = { onTaskClick(task.id) }
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@OptIn(ExperimentalFoundationApi::class)
@Composable
private fun TaskCard(
    task: Task,
    onToggle: () -> Unit,
    onDelete: () -> Unit,
    onClick: () -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier
) {
    Card(
        modifier = modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
            .combinedClickable(
                onClick = onClick,
                role = Role.Button
            ),
        elevation = CardDefaults.cardElevation(defaultElevation = 2.dp)
    ) {
        Row(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .padding(16.dp),
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
        ) {
            IconButton(onClick = onToggle) {
                Icon(
                    imageVector = if (task.isCompleted) Icons.Default.CheckCircle else Icons.Default.RadioButtonUnchecked,
                    contentDescription = if (task.isCompleted) "Mark Incomplete" else "Mark Complete",
                    tint = if (task.isCompleted) MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary else MaterialTheme.colorScheme.outline
                )
            }
            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(8.dp))
            Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                Text(
                    text = task.title,
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium.copy(
                        textDecoration = if (task.isCompleted) TextDecoration.LineThrough else TextDecoration.None
                    ),
                    color = if (task.isCompleted) MaterialTheme.colorScheme.outline else MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurface
                )
                if (task.description.isNotBlank()) {
                    Text(
                        text = task.description,
                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
                    )
                }
            }
            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(8.dp))
            PriorityBadge(priority = task.priority)
            IconButton(onClick = onDelete) {
                Icon(
                    imageVector = Icons.Default.Delete,
                    contentDescription = "Delete Task",
                    tint = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.error
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun PriorityBadge(priority: Priority) {
    val (color, text) = when (priority) {
        Priority.LOW -> MaterialTheme.colorScheme.tertiary to "LOW"
        Priority.MEDIUM -> MaterialTheme.colorScheme.secondary to "MED"
        Priority.HIGH -> MaterialTheme.colorScheme.error to "HIGH"
    }

    Box(
        modifier = Modifier
            .background(color.copy(alpha = 0.15f), shape = RoundedCornerShape(4.dp))
            .padding(horizontal = 6.dp, vertical = 2.dp)
    ) {
        Text(text = text, style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall, color = color)
    }
}

@Composable
private fun CreateTaskBottomSheet(
    onDismiss: () -> Unit,
    onConfirm: (title: String, desc: String, priority: Priority) -> Unit
) {
    val sheetState = rememberModalBottomSheetState(skipPartiallyExpanded = true)
    var title by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf("") }
    var description by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf("") }
    var selectedPriority by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(Priority.MEDIUM) }

    ModalBottomSheet(
        onDismissRequest = onDismiss,
        sheetState = sheetState
    ) {
        Column(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .padding(24.dp),
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(16.dp)
        ) {
            Text("Create New Task", style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineSmall)

            OutlinedTextField(
                value = title,
                onValueChange = { title = it },
                label = { Text("Title") },
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().testTag("TaskTitleInput"),
                singleLine = true
            )

            OutlinedTextField(
                value = description,
                onValueChange = { description = it },
                label = { Text("Description") },
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().testTag("TaskDescInput"),
                minLines = 3
            )

            Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                Priority.entries.forEach { priority ->
                    FilterChip(
                        selected = selectedPriority == priority,
                        onClick = { selectedPriority = priority },
                        label = { Text(priority.name) }
                    )
                }
            }

            Row(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.End
            ) {
                TextButton(onClick = onDismiss) { Text("Cancel") }
                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(8.dp))
                Button(
                    onClick = { onConfirm(title, description, selectedPriority) },
                    enabled = title.isNotBlank(),
                    modifier = Modifier.testTag("SaveTaskButton")
                ) {
                    Text("Save Task")
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.enterprise.app

import android.os.Bundle

import androidx.activity.enableEdgeToEdge

import androidx.lifecycle.compose.collectAsStateWithLifecycle
import androidx.lifecycle.viewmodel.compose.viewModel
import androidx.navigation.compose.NavHost
import androidx.navigation.compose.composable
import androidx.navigation.compose.rememberNavController
import androidx.navigation.toRoute
import com.enterprise.app.data.DefaultTaskRepository
import com.enterprise.app.data.TaskRepository
import com.enterprise.app.navigation.Route
import com.enterprise.app.presentation.TaskViewModel
import com.enterprise.app.ui.screens.TaskDetailScreen
import com.enterprise.app.ui.screens.TaskListRoute
import com.enterprise.app.ui.theme.EnterpriseAppTheme

class MainActivity : ComponentActivity() {

    // Simple manual DI container; replace with Hilt or Koin in large multi-module codebases
    private val taskRepository: TaskRepository by lazy { DefaultTaskRepository() }

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        enableEdgeToEdge()

        setContent {
            EnterpriseAppTheme {
                val navController = rememberNavController()

                NavHost(
                    navController = navController,
                    startDestination = Route.TaskList
                ) {
                    composable<Route.TaskList> {
                        val viewModel: TaskViewModel = viewModel {
                            TaskViewModel(taskRepository)
                        }
                        val uiState by viewModel.uiState.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()

                        TaskListRoute(
                            uiState = uiState,
                            notifications = viewModel.notifications,
                            onAction = viewModel::onAction,
                            onNavigateToDetail = { taskId ->
                                navController.navigate(Route.TaskDetail(taskId = taskId))
                            }
                        )
                    }

                    composable<Route.TaskDetail> { backStackEntry ->
                        val route: Route.TaskDetail = backStackEntry.toRoute()
                        TaskDetailScreen(
                            taskId = route.taskId,
                            repository = taskRepository,
                            onBackClick = { navController.popBackStack() }
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

import kotlinx.coroutines.test.setMain
import org.junit.After
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Before
import org.junit.Test

@OptIn(ExperimentalCoroutinesApi::class)
class TaskViewModelTest {

    private val testDispatcher = StandardTestDispatcher()
    private lateinit var repository: DefaultTaskRepository
    private lateinit var viewModel: TaskViewModel

    @Before
    fun setUp() {
        Dispatchers.setMain(testDispatcher)
        repository = DefaultTaskRepository(ioDispatcher = testDispatcher)
        viewModel = TaskViewModel(repository)
    }

    @After
    fun tearDown() {
        Dispatchers.resetMain()
    }

    @Test
    fun initialState_emitsLoadingThenSuccess() = runTest {
        viewModel.uiState.test {
            assertEquals(TaskUiState.Loading, awaitItem())
            testDispatcher.scheduler.advanceUntilIdle()
            val item = awaitItem()
            assertTrue(item is TaskUiState.Success)
            assertEquals(3, (item as TaskUiState.Success).tasks.size)
            cancelAndIgnoreRemainingEvents()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun filtering_updatesListCorrectly() = runTest {
        viewModel.uiState.test {
            awaitItem() // Loading
            testDispatcher.scheduler.advanceUntilIdle()
            awaitItem() // Success initial

            viewModel.onAction(TaskUiAction.FilterToggleToggled(true))
            testDispatcher.scheduler.advanceUntilIdle()

            val state = awaitItem() as TaskUiState.Success
            assertTrue(state.filterCompleted)
            // Initial map has 1 completed, 2 incomplete -> filtered returns 2
            assertEquals(2, state.tasks.size)
            cancelAndIgnoreRemainingEvents()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun createTask_addsTaskToRepositoryState() = runTest {
        viewModel.uiState.test {
            awaitItem() // Loading
            testDispatcher.scheduler.advanceUntilIdle()
            awaitItem() // Success

            viewModel.onAction(
                TaskUiAction.CreateTask(
                    title = "Integrate Payments",
                    description = "Add Google Pay API",
                    priority = Priority.HIGH
                )
            )
            testDispatcher.scheduler.advanceUntilIdle()

            val updatedState = awaitItem() as TaskUiState.Success
            assertEquals(4, updatedState.tasks.size)
            assertTrue(updatedState.tasks.any { it.title == "Integrate Payments" })
            cancelAndIgnoreRemainingEvents()
        }
    }
}

### Verification and Operational Considerations

1. **Recomposition Guardrails**: 
   - Never instantiate complex objects directly in composable bodies without wrapping in `remember`.
   - Never invoke async suspending logic directly inside composables; invoke actions via hoisted callback lambdas dispatched to a `CoroutineScope` or use `LaunchedEffect(key)`.
2. **State Subscriptions**:
   - Always use `collectAsStateWithLifecycle()` instead of `collectAsState()` in Android UI layers. It automatically stops emission when the app transitions into the background, preventing resource leaks.
3. **Edge-to-Edge Compliance**:
   - `enableEdgeToEdge()` requires handling system window insets via `Modifier.padding(innerPadding)` provided by `Scaffold` or through `Modifier.windowInsetsPadding(WindowInsets.systemBars)`. Failure to do so will result in views clipping behind the status bar or gesture navigation bar.
